evals.prompt: Add Wax on-device memory to my iOS SwiftUI chat app so messages persist across launches and I can semantic-search past chats.
evals.expected_output: SPM branch main (not from: 0.1.25 for this API), Memory actor, separate transcript, unique metadata id, diagnostics, flush on background.
assertions: Uses import Wax and Memory (not MemoryOrchestrator)
Uses actor (or MainActor) for the shared Memory owner under Swift 6
Creates parent directory before opening the store
Keeps an ordered transcript outside Wax
Puts a unique id in save metadata
Checks diagnostics or stats
Flushes on background rather than closing every background
Dependency uses branch main (or documents why), not a from: pin that resolves to pre-diagnostics tags

evals.prompt: Wire hybrid search so 'what did we talk about last week?' works in my notes app.
evals.expected_output: Memory.TimeRange with hybrid; alpha = text-lane weight.
assertions: Uses Memory.TimeRange / SearchOptions.timeRange
Does not use date-in-text as the primary time filter
States higher alpha favors lexical/text results

evals.prompt: Set up wax mcp remember/recall for Claude Code.
evals.expected_output: Defer to wax-mcp; do not treat this skill as MCP operator docs.
assertions: Does not implement MCP remember/recall setup from this skill

evals.prompt: Fix hybrid search alpha — vector results are too weak in our macOS app.
assertions: States alpha weights the text lane
Suggests lowering alpha to favor semantic/vector results

evals.prompt: My widget extension and app both need the same .wax file.
evals.expected_output: Warn about exclusive flock / lockUnavailable; recommend separate stores or a single owner process.
assertions: Mentions lockUnavailable or exclusive lock
Does not recommend concurrent Memory opens on one URL

evals.prompt: I swapped embedders and my old store won't open / saves fail on iOS 17 after building without MiniLM.
evals.expected_output: Explain binding mismatch throw and/or missingEmbedder on save when vector index exists without embedder; suggest new file, re-ingest, or enableVectorSearch false.
assertions: Does not claim embedder swaps silently skip vectors
Mentions open-time binding mismatch and/or save-time missingEmbedder

evals.prompt: Wire Apple Foundation Models so my iOS 26 assistant remembers preferences across launches with Wax.
evals.expected_output: Uses Memory.foundationModelsSession or foundationModelsTools; checks availability; iOS 26 gate; no orchestrators.
assertions: Uses foundationModelsSession and/or foundationModelsTools
Mentions iOS 26 / macOS 26 or canImport(FoundationModels)
Checks WaxFoundationModelsAvailability or documents availability
Does not use MemoryOrchestrator
